summary: Frontend-only testing for Save Draft (localStorage) + touch pinch-zoom/pan features on /editor. All 24 targeted assertions passed. Verified touch-action:none CSS, save-draft-button triggers toast + history entry + valid JSON in localStorage key photoedit_draft_v1 (with data/w/h/savedAt), restore banner appears on reload with Restore/Discard buttons, Discard clears both banner and localStorage, drawn green brush stroke pixels are preserved through save+reload+restore cycle (1945 green pixels before and after), two-finger pinch-out increases zoom (66% -> 198%), pinch-in decreases (198% -> 33%), zoom clamped within [25,200], two-finger pan changes canvas-stage scroll offset, adding a second pointer during a brush stroke cancels drawing (no crop-overlay leak, no residual rubberBand). Regression: /ads.txt served with google.com content, home page loads, File/Edit/Image/Filter menus open, brush shows color+size controls, Export PNG triggers download, Undo/Redo clickable after save+restore cycle.
critical_code_review_comments: Editor.jsx is now 819 lines — approaching maintainability limit; consider extracting draft/pointer/canvas helpers into hooks (useDraft, usePinchZoom) to keep under ~700 lines.
saveDraft catches all errors as 'Draft too large to save' — QuotaExceededError is likely but other exceptions (SecurityError, canvas taint) would be misreported; distinguish or log the error.

restoreDraft accepts data URL directly into setImage without validating it is a data:image/* URL — a corrupted localStorage entry from another app writing the same key could be attempted; a light prefix check would harden it.

pinchRef is cleared in onPointerUp when pointer count >= 1, but if the second pointer's pointerup is missed (e.g., pointercancel) the residual pointer stays in pointersRef; consider adding onPointerCancel handler to clean up pointersRef.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_7 covered Save Draft + touch gestures fully. localStorage key is photoedit_draft_v1. Touch events dispatched via synthetic PointerEvent with pointerType:'touch' work correctly against React's onPointerDown/Move/Up handlers on the canvas. history-row-0 is only rendered when the History tab is active (click [data-testid=history-tab] first). Draft banner appears on mount when localStorage has entry — must reload page to trigger.
